title: Recipe 33 — Prompt Caching (rotate the marker before the TTL rotates you)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “A big stable system prompt re-sent all day is the case caching was built for — about a nine-times cut on the input bill.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the cost-trace beat at the end.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the harness caching is worth having

beats.label: Type recipe 01's harness
beats.cue: “Caching is per-deployment runtime wiring, not spec surface — so start from the plainest agent, unchanged.”

beats.label: Add the showcase's compaction block
beats.cue: “The pairing the recipe names: compaction keeps the cacheable prefix stable across a long session, so the marker keeps getting hit.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Clean — and notice there is nothing cache-shaped in the file. That is the point.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “No cache_control, no rotateAfterMs, no marker anywhere in the IR. The adapter receives already-marked blocks; the spec never mentions it.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target cli — compaction lands, caching is absent by design

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, boots it: GREEN, gated only on the credential the spec itself declares.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “runChatLoop is the only cache-aware step in the whole path, and it is one call inside a package you can read.”

beats.label: Set up three system blocks
beats.cue: “Two stable blocks carrying old markers, one dynamic block last — and a marker that was last refreshed eight days ago.”

beats.label: Type the recipe's manage() call
beats.cue: “The whole API: blocks in, blocks out, plus the timestamp the caller persists. The manager holds no state of its own.”

beats.label: Print the verdict
beats.cue: “One line to show which block ends up carrying the marker.”

beats.label: Run it
beats.cue: “rotated: true, and the markers read dot dot dot-filled — the old ones stripped, one fresh marker on the last block. Eight days is past the seven-day default, and nowhere near Anthropic's thirty-day TTL.”

verify.note: prints “rotated: true” and “markers: · · ●” — intermediates stripped, fresh marker on the last block

beats.label: Ask the adapters their caching policy
beats.cue: “The adapter declares it, not the manager: Anthropic is explicit, OpenAI is automatic. That one string is the whole gate.”
beats.command: bun -e 'import { AnthropicAdapter } from "@crewhaus/adapter-anthropic"; import { OpenAIAdapter } from "@crewhaus/adapter-openai"; console.log("anthropic:", new AnthropicAdapter({ client: {} as any, isOAuth: false }).features.caching); console.log("openai:", new OpenAIAdapter({ client: {} as any } as any).features.caching);'

verify.note: prints “anthropic: explicit” and “openai: automatic” — read off the real adapter classes

beats.label: Run manage() against OpenAI features
beats.cue: “Same call, same blocks, and it does nothing at all — OpenAI caches server-side, so marking would just cost you a write.”
beats.command: bun -e 'import { OpenAIAdapter } from "@crewhaus/adapter-openai"; import { manage } from "@crewhaus/prompt-cache-manager"; const o = new OpenAIAdapter({ client: {} as any } as any); const r = manage([{ type: "text", text: "instructions" }, { type: "text", text: "skills" }], { features: o.features, lastRotatedAt: 0 }); console.log("caching:", o.features.caching, "· rotated:", r.rotated, "· markers written:", r.blocks.filter((b: any) => b.cache_control).length);'

verify.note: prints “caching: automatic · rotated: false · markers written: 0” — the skip branch, with lastRotatedAt: 0 which would otherwise force a rotation

beats.label: Run the recipe's own smoke
beats.cue: “Probe four is this recipe: backdate by eight days, assert a fresh marker went in and the old ones came out. Credential-free, and it is in CI.”

verify.note: five probes pass; probe 4 is prompt-cache-manager's rotation assertion

groups.title: One more thing · prove it on the bill

beats.label: Type the recipe's cost_accrual event
beats.cue: “The two token counts are disjoint: inputTokens is the fresh, full-price prefix; cachedReadTokens is what came out of cache at a tenth of the rate.”

beats.label: Compute the cache-hit ratio
beats.cue: “cachedReadTokens over the total — 0.966. A healthy long-prompt agent climbs toward one; a low number means the marker is ageing out or the prompt is churning.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const a = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("live/cost-accrual.json", "utf8")); const r = a.cachedReadTokens / (a.inputTokens + a.cachedReadTokens); console.log("fresh:", a.inputTokens, "· cached:", a.cachedReadTokens, "· cache-hit ratio:", r.toFixed(3));'

verify.note: prints “fresh: 348 · cached: 9892 · cache-hit ratio: 0.966” — and doubles as a parse check on the typed JSON

beats.label: Watch the real per-call costs
beats.cue: [needs-key] “CREWHAUS_TRACE_COST=1 echoes every cost_accrual to stderr — on a warm cache the first call pays the write and the rest ride the prefix.”
beats.command: CREWHAUS_TRACE_COST=1 crewhaus optimize live/crewhaus.yaml 2>&1 | grep cost-call

verify.note: the recipe's own worked observation; optimize makes real model calls, so this needs Anthropic credentials
